newsitem.title: USA: Strategists tell Hong Kong stock picks - BARRON'S.
newsitem.headline: Strategists tell Hong Kong stock picks - BARRON'S.

text.p: When asked to select Hong Kong and other Asian stocks to buy, strategists offered a range of recommendations, including the following picks, according to Barron's:

Elizabeth Tran, chief Asian investment director for IDS Fund Management, said she believed retailer Goldlion Holdings Ltd will grow from geographical expansion in China and new product lines. She estimates earnings for the fiscal year ended March 31, 1997 of HK$0.42 vs HK$0.38 last year, and earnings for 1998 of HK$0.50.
Bradbury's target price for HSBC is HK$215 a share. Tran also likes HSBC, but said she would wait for a buying opportunity around 160. HSBC closed at 180 on Thursday.

Peter Churchouse, Asia-ex-Japan strategist for Morgan Stanley and its Hong Kong property sector analyst said he thinks underlying demand in the Hong Kong property market is so strong that upward momentum, particularly in residential prices, will be maintained despite government intervention.
Churchouse said he likes Sun Hung Kai Properties because it is extremely well run and has an unusually large land bank.
His price target is HK$108 by year-end 1997. The stock closed at 85.25 Thursday.
Churchouse said conglomerate Hutchison Whampoa is the "quintessential proxy" for the H.K. market. His target price for the stock, which closed Thursday at HK$58.25, is HK$73 in 12 months.
